title: Decide from immutable inventory facts
scenario: The warehouse fulfillment desk has 5 units of catalog item 1; a customer order asks for 3. A stock read can go stale before the write, so first isolate what policy can promise: approval against observed facts, not a completed reservation.
instructions: In src/domain/policy.rs implement decide. Compare command and observation item IDs first; return ObservationMismatch when they differ. Otherwise reject a requested quantity above observed availability with InsufficientObservedInventory. For sufficient matching stock, return an intent containing the command item and quantity. Do not perform I/O or mutate either input.

hints.body: Policy reads two immutable values. Check identity before comparing quantity with observed availability.
The intent is built from the command's item and quantity. It must not include the observation or its stock value.
Return ObservationMismatch first, then InsufficientObservedInventory; otherwise construct ReservationIntent with the command fields.

completionExplanation: The order for 3 fits the observed 5, so policy returns an intent. Nothing is reserved yet. Next, wire that proposal through the application service without letting a missing item or rejected request reach commit.
